entries.description: Read project-guidance, prerequisite change-log, dabbler-uat-dsl source surface (CLI Program.cs, schema, grammar, SuppressionMatcher); confirmed catalog has schemaVersion 1.1 with isWatermarked field, schema/component-catalog.json file is at v1.0 (no isWatermarked) — doc will describe v1.1 contract per spec.
Authored dabbler-uat-dsl/docs/language-reference.md (closed verb list, structured VERIFY forms, scope rules, watermark synchronization, locator rules, closed-list extension policy, worked example).

Authored dabbler-uat-dsl/docs/cli-reference.md (validate/compile flags, JSON output shapes, exit codes, ValidationErrorKind table, --active-role + AnyRole sentinel notes, common workflows, known limitations).
Authored dabbler-uat-dsl/docs/data-contracts.md (catalog schema 1.0/1.1 with isWatermarked, suppressions schema with match algorithm, round-trip contract diagram).
Updated dabbler-uat-dsl/README.md with Documentation section linking the three new docs and dabbler-platform/COMPATIBILITY.md, plus a How-this-fits-in pointer back to the AI-led workflow.
Created dabbler-platform/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md with current supported combination table (Core 1.2.0 / Cli 1.2.1 / Emitters 1.1.0 / catalog 1.1) and bump procedure.

Refactored project-guidance.md Catalog-Grounded UAT Checklist Authoring + closed-verb-list Conventions to link to dabbler-uat-dsl docs instead of restating verb syntax + CLI flags. Integration commentary (watermark pairing rule, W2 runner role-inference, click-driven-cursor known limitation) retained in dabbler-platform.

dotnet build clean (0 errors, 184 warnings — all pre-existing CS0618 obsolete + CS8604 nullable from prior sets); 709/709 non-Playwright unit/integration/bUnit tests pass (Components 43, Security.Blazor 200, Api 27, Reports.Blazor 16, Security 300, Web 123). Doc-only set, no code change expected to affect tests.

Cross-provider verification: gemini-pro tier 2 ($0.0313, 25s) — flagged Three-Step Discipline collapse but that is Session 2 Step 4 work per spec; disposition: VERIFIED for Session 1, false positive (out of scope). Note: first call landed on tier-3 Opus (same-provider, $1.24 wasted, known router penalty); re-routed with max_tier=2 to force cross-provider. Verifier returned narrative instead of required JSON block — verifier-format observation tracked in session-001.md.
